email.subject: AI for McElroy, Deutsch, Mulvaney & Carpenter, LLP built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

With 175 attorneys across litigation, labor and employment, and bankruptcy practices, McElroy, Deutsch, Mulvaney & Carpenter is exactly the kind of diverse firm facing pressure to scale efficiency without compromising the client-first approach that's defined your practice since 1983.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-sized practices: precision, client trust, and measurable efficiency gains.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Morristown to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete without losing their identity.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
